title: IST-Africa 2027 Conference
field: ICT for development (including AI, big data, eHealth, cybersecurity)
about: IST-Africa 2027, a virtual conference in May 2027, invites 8-page full papers through an open call with double-blind review. Themes include technology-enabled healthcare and next-generation computing (AI, big data, cloud, IoT) and cybersecurity. Extended deadline: 20 November 2026.
requirements: Full papers of 8 pages following the IST-Africa paper guidelines and template

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research writing" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"Full papers of 8 pages following the IST-Africa paper guidelines and template" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Double-blind peer review" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."

card_alt: Card for the IST-Africa 2027 Conference, organised by IST-Africa: a virtual (remote) conference with a paper submission deadline of 20 Nov 2026. The default photo is an aerial view at sunset of a city skyline with a tall spire-topped tower beside a winding river.
